account_last_provider_hint: It is your only way to sign in, so it cannot be unlinked.

account_link_unavailable: To add another way to sign in, we first have to confirm it is you, and none of your linked ways to sign in is available right now. Try again once one of them is back.
account_unlink_disabled_hint: This way to sign in is switched off for now, so it cannot be unlinked while that lasts.
account_logout_all_help: Closes your session on every device, this one included.
preferences_save_failed: We could not save the theme in your profile. It stays on this device.
fight_view_error: We couldn't load the card. We'll keep trying.
fight_view_commit_help: Revealed after the fight so anyone can check it.
fight_view_halted: Fights are on hold because of a problem on our end. This page will update on its own when they're back.
fight_result_voided: Voided due to a technical problem
fight_result_voided_unverifiable: Voided: stakes were returned and it cannot be verified
fight_notice_degraded: We couldn't connect you live. We'll keep trying. The result will show up here.
fight_notice_playback_error: We couldn't show the animation. The result will show up here.
fight_notice_no_animation: This browser can't show the animation.
replay_list_lead: Fights that already ended, without telling you how.
replay_list_empty: No fight has ended yet. The first one will be live.
replay_pending_text: This fight has not ended yet.
replay_final_missed_window: It was not held: it missed its slot.
replay_final_fight_unrunnable: It was not held: it could not be prepared.
replay_final_snapshot_invalid: It was voided: the fighters' data was damaged. Its seed was published.
replay_final_engine_error: It was voided: the engine could not finish it. Its seed was published.
replay_final_secret_lost: It was voided and cannot be verified: its seed was lost. Bets were refunded.
replay_verify_checking: Checking this fight in your browser…
replay_verify_match_fight: It matches. The seed is the number that decides how the fight goes, and the seal is its fingerprint: it lets you check the seed without revealing it. The published seed corresponds to the published seal and, with this seed and these fighters, the engine produces exactly this fight, result included.
replay_verify_match_commit: It matches. The seed is the number that would have decided the fight, and the seal is its fingerprint. The published seed corresponds to the published seal. This fight was voided, so there is no fight to simulate.
replay_verify_match_snapshot: It matches. The published fighters correspond to their published fingerprint. This fight was not held and had no seed.
replay_verify_mismatch: It does not match. The published data does not reproduce this fight. It may be our mistake or altered data: we cannot tell from here.
replay_verify_mismatch_state: The response does not describe a finished fight.
replay_verify_mismatch_commit: The seed does not correspond to the seal.
replay_verify_mismatch_snapshot: The fighters do not correspond to their fingerprint.
replay_verify_mismatch_log: The fight does not come out the same.
replay_verify_mismatch_final: The result is not the one of the fight.
replay_verify_mismatch_summary: The summary does not match the fight or its rules.
replay_verify_cannot_check: Could not check. Your browser could not run the test. This says nothing about the fight.
replay_verify_cannot_check_ruleset: Could not check. This fight uses rules (version {n}) this version of the site does not know. Reload the page. This says nothing about the fight.
replay_verify_cannot_check_final: Could not check. This version of the site does not know this kind of ending. Reload the page. This says nothing about the fight.
replay_verify_not_applicable: Nothing to check: this fight was not held and never had a seed.
replay_verify_limit: The seal is published before the fight, but this page cannot prove that on its own: anyone who saw or saved it before the fight can compare it. It does not prove the seed came out at random either.
replay_verify_more_text: Whoever controls the site could have tried several seeds and sealed the one that suited them. Nor can this data be taken as the original unless someone saved a copy. The check runs on code this site gives you: to avoid relying on it, the engine is open and you can run it on this data.
replay_verify_more_text_no_seed: This data cannot be taken as the original unless someone saved a copy. The check runs on code this site gives you: to avoid relying on it, the engine is open and you can run it on this data.
replay_copy_manual: Select it and copy it by hand
